title: Your account gets deleted in 9 minutes
scenario: A Discord message says your gaming account was reported for cheating and will be deleted in nine minutes unless you complete a “player appeal.” The link already shows your gamer tag and profile picture.

answers.A: Open the game’s official app/site yourself and check account notices or support there.
answers.B: Ask a parent, trusted adult, or friend to help verify the support message before logging in anywhere.
answers.C: Use the appeal link because it already knows your gamer tag and the timer is running.

explanation: Public profile details are easy to copy. Real account actions should appear inside the game’s own support system.
proTip: A countdown is trying to borrow your decision-making.
